General -This `Specification for polystyrene film dielectric capacitors: Part I General requirements and methods of tests ( first revision ) `. Covers polystyrene film dielectric capacitors, tubular, non-hermetically sealed 1. Scopenon-metal case, insulated, extended foil low inductance axial terminations, wrap and fill type. 7.1 General Conditions of Tests - See 8.2 of IS : 5475 ( Part I )-1978. be used for any one test but not necessarily for all the tests.

7.1.1 Mounting -The capacitors shall be mounted by a bracket or clamp, or they shall be potted when vibration or shock are likely to be encountered in use. When a clamp or bracket is used, case shall be taken to ensure that the body of the capacitor is not deformed. 7.1.2 The test schedule and the requirements shall be in accordance with Table 2.
